ops.reduce: jnp.<func>(array, axis=axis) on one array. params: key (npz key or null), func, axis (int or null = all elements).
ops.map: Elementwise <func> applied with jax.vmap over the leading axis (shape preserved). params: key, func.
ops.logistic_grad: jax.grad of mean(logaddexp(0, -y * (x @ w))) with respect to w, evaluated at the w from the file. params: x_key, y_key, w_key, labels ('pm1' or '01' -> mapped to 2y-1).
ops.rnn_scan: jax.lax.scan of h_t = tanh(Wx @ x_t + Wh @ h_{t-1} + b) over the leading (time) axis of seq; returns every h_t stacked (T, H). params: seq_key, Wx_key, Wh_key, b_key, h0_key (null = zeros(H)), wx_side ('left' = Wx @ x, 'right' = x @ Wx), wh_side ('left' = Wh @ h, 'right' = h @ Wh), activation.
ops.mlp_forward: jax.jit-compiled forward pass: h = act(x @ W1 + b1); out = h @ W2 + b2 (activation on hidden layers only, final layer linear). params: x_key, layers ([[W_key, b_key], ...] in order), activation, w_side ('right' = x @ W, 'left' = x @ W.T).
